The Chinese characters for Oliver

As a transliteration, Oliver is usually written 奥利弗 (Ào lì fú). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

奥
Ào
profound, Austria
利
lì
sharp, benefit
弗
fú
not

Origin and meaning

Oliver comes from Latin and means “olive tree”.

About the name Oliver

A literary favourite from Charles Dickens' Oliver Twist.
